{"metadata":{"description":"Per-model LLM call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject support and interactive GUI configuration.","id":"gh:1367456365","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-llm-rate-limiter","slug":"Leafyezi233/dsh-llm-rate-limiter","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Per-model LLM call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject support and interactive GUI c"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject support and interactive GUI configuration."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-llm-rate-limiter"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Per-model LLM call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject support and interactive GUI c"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" call rate limiter for DeepSeek Harness with queue/reject support and interactive GUI configuration."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Per-model rate limiting** — independent concurrency, RPM, and burst limits for each `provider/mo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"del`
- **Two algorithms** — Token Bucket (allows bursts) or Sliding Window (smooth, strict RPM)
- **"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"Queue mode** — throttled requests wait in queue and are released when a slot opens
- **Reject mode**"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" — throttled requests fail immediately (integrates with `dsh-llm-retry` for auto-backoff)
- **Intera"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"ctive GUI** — collapsible card in DSH Settings → Plugins → Configurable
- **Live status panel** — re"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"al-time counters, per-model progress bars and an event log (v0.2.0)
- **Hot-reload** — settings chan"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"ges take effect immediately, no restart needed
- **Every request checked** — intercepts `llm/stream`"},{"id":"p6s8","text":" waterfall, covering every LLM call in every agent turn"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Status Panel (v0.2.0)"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Expanding the card shows a live panel at the top of its body:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Aspect | Behaviour |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Data channel | Channel `/llm-rate-limiter` — authenticated (401/403 fence), POST+JSON, auto-cleane"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"d with the plugin fiber |
| Carrier | Prefers the framework's `connection.rpc.handle()`; falls back "},{"id":"p11s3","text":"to a self-registered prefix route that reuses `connection.requestRejection()` when the framework pat"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"h is broken (see below) |
| Cadence | 1 s polling while the card is expanded; backs off 2 s → 4 s → "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"8 s after failures |
| Collapsed card | The panel unmounts, so **no polling runs at all** |
| Endpoi"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"nts | `snapshot` (live counters) and `reset` (zero the statistics) |
| Without a channel | Shows "状态"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"通道不可用" and leaves the rest of the card fully functional |
| Counters | `requests` / `granted` / `rej"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"ected` / `timeouts` / `aborted` / `totalWaitMs`, plus the last 8 events (ring buffer of 64) |
| Prog"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"ress bars | Token bucket shows `tokens/burstSize`; sliding window shows `countInWindow/maxRpm`; both"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" turn amber as the limit approaches |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Carrier fallback (DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 onward)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DSH 0.1.5-rc.3 changed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection`'s own `inject` from
`["webServer", "cred"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"entials"]` to `["credentials"]`, but its
`HostConnectionService.register()` still dereferences `owne"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"r.webServer`.
Cordis rebinds a cross-fiber service's `ctx` to the *reader's* fiber, so
`connection.r"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"pc.handle()` throws: **still present in 0.1.7-rc.1** — see below."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The plugin now detects that and mounts the same channel itself:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Path | When | How |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 1 (preferred) | `connection.rpc.handle()` works | The framework owns the route, request validation"},{"id":"p17s2","text":", and fiber-scoped withdrawal |
| 2 (fallback) | Path 1 throws | The plugin registers a `kind: "pref"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ix"` route on its own fiber (which *can* see `webServer`) and reuses `connection.requestRejection()`"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" for the 403/401 fence |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Both carriers speak the identical wire protocol, so **the browser half is
unchanged** — the panel ca"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"nnot tell which one is live. If
`connection.requestRejection()` is unavailable, the plugin refuses t"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"o mount
